svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural

g.title: cseii
g.desc: To Trap, May this new chapter be filled with happiness, genuine friendships, unforgettable memories, and endless blessings. Keep shining and never stop being you! 🎉🥳
